summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a medium score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M]. The official drug label warns of severe allergic reactions, specifically swelling under the skin called angioedema and life-threatening whole-body reactions known as anaphylaxis [3]. People with known severe allergies to the drug or any of its ingredients should avoid using it [3].
